commentary.text: 90+8' The match is over and Alberto Grassi (Empoli) gets a red card for unsporting behaviour.
90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Liam Henderson (Empoli) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Antonio Rapuano saw the whole situation.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' A substitution has been made. Saba Goglichidze is replaced by Junior Sambia (Empoli).
87' The free kick from close range, taken by Fiorentina, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

86' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for an infringement. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ismael Konate (Empoli) for Jacopo Fazzini.
82' Here is a change. Albert Gudmundsson is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina).
80' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
78' Antonio Rapuano shows a yellow card to Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
77' Substitution. Alberto Grassi will be replaced by Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli).
71' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) replaces Lucas Beltran.
70' Michael Folorunsho goes off the pitch and Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) comes on.
67' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' That's the end of the game for Yacine Adli, who is replaced by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
60' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Luca Ranieri and he is replaced by Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
57' 2 - 1 Goal! Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the back of the net.
55' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card for infringement.
53' It's like he was asking for a caution. Liam Henderson (Empoli) receives a yellow card.
47' The resulting set piece from Empoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Roberto D'Aversa gives a chance to Liam Henderson and Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Ola Solbakken (Empoli) will not participate anymore and Lorenzo Colombo is coming on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' The Empoli players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
25' 2 - 0 GOOOOOAL! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) finds space in the box from the lofted pass and lands the perfect scissor-kick goal. G.O.A.T? Probably not, but it’s 2:0.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
20' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
16' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
13' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
7' 1 - 0 Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.

4' Fiorentina are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
